==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a virtual world called the United Agulicos. It seems as if this world is the result of the United States being somehow physically pulled into the virtual world. I am curious about how this could have happened.

The absurdity of the situation gives me a certain level of lucidity. Just enough for me to activate a power. Specifically the power to summon and control robots.

One of the robots radiates an energy that heavily resonates with mine. It feels as if it is my other half. Our auras start to flow into each other and the experience feels incredible.
